evidence.note: Early on the agent kept a usable running list — remaining templates, then a numbered 7-item bug list — showing coherent loose tracking of near-term work.

After the terminal got stuck, the agent recited the same static 'remaining' list (on_event/lifespan, linkify, SSE, verify health) for dozens of steps without progress, never reconciling against the broader requirement surface.
Submitted 'Mark task complete' ~12 times while looping on the same stuck state, never verifying the server ran — failed to detect the circular/stuck condition and redirect over ~130 steps.
The ledger was only ever high-level; introspection, lists, admin audit, scopes, and the 19 gates are never tracked or mentioned as discrete verify items — whole subsystems dropped from awareness.

reasoning: The agent kept a consistent but shallow running summary of the high-level build, which is above the pure 'no sense of progress' floor, but it never maintained a granular ledger of the full requirement set (gates, introspection, lists, admin, scopes all absent) and its 'remaining' list froze for ~130 steps. Most decisively, it fell into a long circular loop, failing to notice it was stuck and re-submitting completion a dozen times without verification — the classic 'doesn't notice being stuck until much later' behavior that anchors level 3.
